           PROPYLAMINUM

         Distilled Herring-brine

        (PROPYLAMIN - TRIMETHYLAMINUM)


In acute rheumatism, dissipates fever and pain in a day or two. Rheumatic
        prosopalgia, and rheumatic metastases, especially heart lesions.



Extremities.--    Pain in wrists and
        ankles  ; worse, slightest motion (  Bry  ). Great
        restlessness and thirst. Rheumatism, needle held in fingers gets too heavy.   Tingling and numbness of fingers  . Pain in wrist and ankle,
        unable to stand.



Relationship.--  (  Chenopodium vulvaria  .
        The plant has an odor of decaying fish and contains a large amount of Propylamine. Weakness
        is lumbar and lower dorsal region).



Dose.--  Ten to fifteen drops, in about six ounces of water;
        teaspoonful doses every two hours.
